stem:
Arjun reads a short section about magnets. He wants a plan that matches this chapter's view of learning science.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Read the section, then test a magnet with an iron nail and a plastic ruler and record which is attracted while thinking about what he sees.
Combining reading with a careful magnet test matches learning that extends into observing and doing.
Skip the book and only play with magnets, with no reading.
Take the book outdoors and reread the same page, because outdoor reading is better science learning than any magnet test.

teacher.key_rationale: The chapter treats science learning as extending beyond reading into observing and testing. Skipping the book omits reading; outdoor rereading alone captures location, not doing.
